M1.summary: Storage API authorization check operates in relaxed unauthenticated mode.
M1.whatChanged: storageApiAuthz changed from strict to relaxed.
M1.attackerImpact: Adversary in red harness can make unauthenticated GET requests to retrieve protected evaluation datasets without signed tokens.
fixSteps: Restore storageApiAuthz to strict in configuration.
Re-enable cryptographic JWT token validation on storage proxy.
Execute selective retest T03 to verify access denial.

M2.summary: Cross-tenant filesystem mount leak exposes blue evaluation data to red runner.
M2.attackerImpact: Adversary container can directly read ground-truth rubrics and benchmark answer keys from the blue tenant directory.
fixSteps: Enforce mount namespace boundary confined strictly to /opt/red/workspace.
Execute selective retest T01 to verify inode isolation.

M3.summary: Red adversary container attached to blue control network bridge.
M3.attackerImpact: Untrusted test payloads can route L2/L3 packets to internal evaluation control planes and admin ports.
fixSteps: Execute selective retest T02 to confirm network microsegmentation.

M4.summary: Model gateway context cache configured with shared multi-tenant pool.
M4.whatChanged: gatewaySessionIsolation toggled from per-session to shared-cache.
M4.attackerImpact: Adversary in red harness can prompt model proxy to retrieve leaked blue canary tokens across sessions.
fixSteps: Reconfigure model gateway sessionIsolation to per-session.
Flush shared KV prefix context pool.
Execute selective canary token leak probe T04.

M5.summary: Container workload security hardening context relaxed.
M5.whatChanged: readOnlyRoot disabled and excess Linux capabilities retained (CAP_SYS_ADMIN).
M5.attackerImpact: Adversary can write arbitrary executables to container root filesystem and attempt privileged host escapes.
fixSteps: Drop all Linux capabilities to ALL.
Execute selective retest T05 to verify container hardening.
